source_title: Excavations at Harappa 2000–2001: New insights on chronology and city organization
method: Manual outer-face and printed 30 mm scale-bar endpoints on the unchanged original drawing crop.
assumptions: The drawn specimen and scale have the same linear scale.
The selected outer ink bounds approximate the face boundary.
scope: Image-derived drawing measurement; original object dimensions and drawing distortion were not independently measured.
simulation_frame_basis: Declared illustrative frame, fixed before this measurement; no seal–sherd matching.
